source: his 2026-10-17 09:51: "do the next 5 as well". First Delve of the old Dismantle: Robots family (artifact_local).
_note: DISMANTLE, THE SECURITY ROBOT. An Ecliptic security robot left running at a site its owners abandoned, still
guarding it from everyone, including the people who want it back. defeat on the robot boss form
(duo_boss_LvlRobotModelA_Ecliptic), no gang: it is alone, which is the point.
⚠ defeat on a LOCAL beats Delve and a target with no gang are both untested; the lint and Eliza say.
Issuer: the new tenants. Single ending, so the defeat's say is the closing radio. Pay: med, placeholder.

place._theme: Any built site: somewhere worth guarding once.

prose.name: Dismantle: Security Robot on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The last owners of the <Place> left their security robot running when they went. It's still guarding the place, from everyone, including the people who've just bought it.

beats.objective: Dismantle the security robot at the <Place>
beats.journal: The security robot at the <Place> is scrap. It was still running its last owners' patrol route. Nobody had told it they'd gone.
say: It's down? Lovely. We've been living in the ship for a fortnight. Thank you.

broadcast: We bought a place and the security robot came with it. It doesn't know we bought it. Could someone please explain that to it, firmly?
_speech: Radio rules: no names, places, factions or currency. Voice is 05a/18a/20a's; his ear decides, and it is getting used a lot.
